presentationRules.informationOnlyCopy: Дополнительная диагностическая информация. Не является подтверждённой командой к действию.
presentationRules.prohibitedCopy: Известен исторический/полевой аварийный приём, но его выполнение не предлагается. Процедура скрыта.
presentationRules.noAdditionalCopy: Для этой ветви отдельный расширенный метод не найден; стандартная диагностика остаётся основной.

profileIsolation.chme3t-rheostatic: Only CHME3-DIAG-110 profile-specific expanded candidate is currently evidenced
profileIsolation.chme3e-electronic: No expanded candidate currently evidenced; do not inherit base ChME3 field schemes
profileIsolation.tem2u-improved: Only explicit TEM2-DIAG-024 TEM2U candidate is currently evidenced

assistantBehaviorExamples.condition: mode OFF and a troubleshooting query matches a standard scenario
assistantBehaviorExamples.behavior: Return the standard diagnostic route only.

assistantBehaviorExamples.condition: mode ON, exact profile matches, INFORMATION_ONLY candidate exists
assistantBehaviorExamples.behavior: Return the standard diagnostic route and immediately attach the turquoise expanded evidence card with source/status; do not convert it into an action.

assistantBehaviorExamples.condition: mode ON, exact profile matches, PROHIBITED candidate exists
assistantBehaviorExamples.behavior: Return the standard diagnostic route and a turquoise status card that a non-standard method exists, with risk/source/status and no procedure.

assistantBehaviorExamples.condition: mode ON but no candidate exists for the exact profile
assistantBehaviorExamples.behavior: Do not inherit a related-series method. Keep the standard route and, only when useful, state that no separate expanded method is evidenced for this profile.
